memoryTip: Serene scene — still water, no wind, no worry.
correctPassage: The lake was serene at dawn, with barely a ripple on the surface.
wrongPassages: The trading floor was serene as alarms blared and phones rang without pause.
Her serene outburst knocked over two chairs before anyone could intervene.
The serene debate featured raised voices, slammed papers, and a walkout.

definition: experienced through another person rather than firsthand
memoryTip: Via someone else — you feel their thrills secondhand.
correctPassage: Readers experience a kind of vicarious adventure through the narrator's travels.
wrongPassages: She earned a vicarious degree by attending every lecture and sitting every exam herself.
His vicarious injury came from the fall he took on the ice, not from watching others.
They planned a vicarious vacation and booked the flights under their own names.

definition: prevent or hinder by taking action ahead of time
memoryTip: Fore-stall: block it before it starts.
correctPassage: Early vaccination campaigns sought to forestall a winter outbreak.
wrongPassages: They waited to forestall the leak until after the basement had already flooded.
Management chose to forestall the crisis by ignoring the first dozen warning emails.
She forestalled the deadline by submitting the report three weeks late.

memoryTip: Dwindle down — shrink little by little until almost gone.
correctPassage: As funding dwindled, the program had to drop several field sites.
wrongPassages: Enrollment dwindled from 40 students to 400 within a single semester.
The surplus dwindled upward after three profitable quarters in a row.
Her confidence dwindled into a bold keynote that filled the largest hall on campus.

definition: tending to provoke a strong reaction, interest, or annoyance
memoryTip: Pro-voke: built to stir a reaction, not to soothe.
correctPassage: The exhibit's provocative title was meant to spark discussion, not offense.
wrongPassages: The lullaby was so provocative that every child fell asleep within minutes.
His provocative apology smoothed every conflict and left no one upset.
Students found the review sheet provocative because it repeated only the easiest drills.
